args.newString:
import asyncio
import hashlib
import inspect
import json

args.command:
python - <<'EOF'
from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

tc = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "search", "args": {"b": " hi ", "a": (1, 2)}}])
c = tc.tool_calls[0]
print(c.fingerprint, c.id)
assert len(c.fingerprint) == 64 and len(c.id) == 8 and c.fingerprint.startswith(c.id)

tc2 = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "search", "args": {"a": [1, 2], "b": "hi"}}])
c2 = tc2.tool_calls[0]
assert c2.fingerprint == c.fingerprint, (c.fingerprint, c2.fingerprint)

import hashlib, json
expected = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({"name": "search", "args": {"a": [1, 2], "b": "hi"}}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
assert c.fingerprint == expected

# model_validate path also computes
m = ToolCalls.model_validate({"tool_calls": [{"name": "x", "args": {}}]})
assert len(m.tool_calls[0].fingerprint) == 64
# bool/int preserved
tc3 = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "t", "args": {"flag": True, "n": 1}}])
assert tc3.tool_calls[0].args == {"flag": True, "n": 1}
print("OK")
EOF
